name: The replay slows down around a cut and the director cuts to the close-up (signed in)
description: Validates the replay clock's slow-down from 6 minutes before a cut to 2 minutes after it (30 times slower) and the director's cut to the close-up at C-Lion1 (16:44 UTC), with the countdown to the next event while playing.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-director-02+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Type 424242 in the verification code field
Wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?t=2024-12-25T16:30Z and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "16:30 UTC" and the Director button (data-testid director-toggle) has data-state "off", since the link names a moment
Click the Director button, click the button labelled "Play replay" (data-testid replay-play), then click "Pause replay" (the same button) as soon as it shows that label, without waiting

Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads a time later than 16:30 and no later than 17:30 UTC: near a cut the replay slows to a few minutes per second, while at normal speed a few seconds would take it past 17:30
Assert the anchor status (data-testid replay-anchor-status) contains "next event in" while the replay plays
Click "Pause replay", then navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?t=2024-12-25T16:45Z and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Click the Director button (data-testid director-toggle) and wait 5 seconds; the replay stays paused at 16:45, one minute after the C-Lion1 cut

Assert the Director button has data-state "on", "At the cut" is pressed in the view switch (data-testid view-switch), and the replay clock still reads "16:45 UTC": during the two minutes after a cut the director holds the close-up
